decision.reason: The only thing shown is that the deprecation log line was removed from cmd/crossplane/core/core.go between v1.20.1 [ev-2875a348b5d7] and v2.0.0 [ev-59d22c21eec4]. Both excerpts are empty ("/*"), so nothing shows whether the --enable-composition-functions flag definition still exists in v2.0.0. Without that, we can't tell whether a pod still passing the flag has it silently ignored (setting-ignored) or gets an unknown-flag error at startup (workload-failure). To decide, we need the flag definitions in core.go at v2.0.0, or a release note or upgrade-guide statement saying what happens to the flag.
